function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the repository checkout. Returns numbered lines. Use start_line and end_line to read a range.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List repository files whose path matches a glob such as crates/*/Cargo.toml or *.rs.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search the repository for an extended regular expression. Returns file:line:text matches, at most 100.

path.description: Directory or file to search. Defaults to the repository root.

function.name: fetch_url
function.description: Fetch an https documentation page as plain text. Only documentation hosts are allowed: api-docs.deepseek.com, docs.rs, doc.rust-lang.org, docs.github.com, crates.io, docs.opencode.ai, opencode.ai, rust-lang.github.io, clap.rs, serde.rs.
